curated-dafont-satisfaction-fs-amulya: Satisfaction hugs its letters tight and sits low, perfect for baby gifts handmade, though never only that. Amulya answers with generous openings in its curves, a contemporary sans-serif that gives the script room to lean on.
curated-dafont-stencilia-gf-hanuman: Stencilia is all structure, with cut gaps and a compact build. Hanuman's classic serif follows with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s, so long paragraphs settle into a refined, traditional rhythm.
curated-fredoka-gf-cardo: Soft, friendly, round-edged. Cardo's classic serif brings literary dignity, its strokes thinning slowly at the arches, so text in it (a kids cooking class flyer, maybe) can go a notch larger than you'd expect.
curated-fredoka-gf-martel: Fredoka draws every stroke with a constant pen line. Martel's classic serif adds moderate contrast and horseshoe-open apertures, so the rounded heading and the editorial text feel like two voices sharing one friendly page, for instance a preschool welcome sign.
curated-fredoka-gf-volkhov: Friendly and approachable, Fredoka holds each stroke like a drawn cable. Volkhov's text serif moves with the soft thick-thin shift of pencil, so the page gets a steady rounded voice up top and a gentler, editorial one below.
curated-fs-array-bitter: Futuristic and precise, Array leaves its curves open and its lowercase eyes large. Bitter's slab-serif has a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s, so a longer stretch of it reads grounded and dependable.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-elms-sans: Bonny sets literary, refined letters with understated stroke variation, ideal for something like an engraved leatherwork stamp. Elms Sans, a modern sans-serif, draws a pressure-free line with a see-through gap in each s, so longer text moves along smoothly.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian is a clean, contemporary sans-serif with loose curves that never knot at the ends. Under Bonny, a literary serif with quiet stroke modulation and tight-set lines, it gives the page a refined top and an open, modern text.
curated-fs-britney-gf-m-plus-code-latin: M PLUS Code Latin reads like neon tubing, a sans-serif with wide pitcher-mouthed c shapes. Britney's calligraphic hand, tightly spaced and relaxed, adds expressive flourish up top, handy for, say, a wedding invitation, and the body keeps brief copy approachable.
curated-fs-britney-gf-tiro-devanagari-ma: Relaxed and expressive, Britney writes in a calligraphic hand with narrow room around every letter. Big and short is where it works, while Tiro Devanagari Marathi, an editorial serif, glitters with dark and light strokes for brief copy.
